patterns.what_worked: Pure-first split: the playhead geometry and the cadence schedule went into practice.lua (WoW-free), so 49 pins landed in practice_state and the new self-contained practice_timeline suite before any frame existed. The strip then reused those helpers verbatim, and 19/19 mutations died on /tmp/opencode copies.
patterns.what_was_hard: The archive's log looked like a timeline but is a post-fight review (icons at past fight time, scrollbar pinned to the newest end) - the operator's 'doesn't work' is that there was never a cue. And class drills had NO timeline at all: no frame shown, no toggle built, so the fix had to be a new default view, not a tweak of the existing renderer.
patterns.skill_gap: The class lanes still publish no 'upcoming' provider, so the operator's hunter sees the neutral rotation-cadence preview (labelled as such) rather than the real forced-move windows. That wiring needs classes/hunter.lua, outside this lane's scope.

escalation.recommendation: Operator in-client read of the strip (bench §D); then dispatch the hunter 'upcoming' provider follow-up against the contract in bench §B; orchestrator adds the run.sh line for tests/practice_timeline_state.lua.
